chapter: Radio, Jazz Record and Blue Note (Reel 2)
title: The collectors bring Bunk Johnson's band to New York
summary: The collectors dug Bunk Johnson up, got him teeth and a trumpet and brought him to New York with George Lewis, Jim Robinson and Baby Dodds. Hodes listened every night.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Just rehearsed and made the date. So into this scene the collectors, especially the Jazz Information, because I like to think of Ralph Gleason and Gene Williams and Rudy Blesh and people like that, began to reach out to do more. And that's how they bought -- they found Bunk Johnson and brought him to New York. And that's a story. I mean, they dug him up and they got him store teeth. And this has been told. And they got him a trumpet. And they handpicked the band for him. And I think he had something to say about it, but --
George Lewis, Jim Robinson and Baby Dodds.
And they brought this band up to New York.

I heard that band every night that they were up there. And it was a band that had its own way of playing. It was an original, and I'd never heard this kind of music before. Didn't want to sit in, I just wanted to sit and listen to it every night.
